name: quartet-arrival
prompt: A cappella counterpoint about four voices completing a loop. Three voices have sung together for a long time; the fourth has always been missing, an unoccupied register, a gap in the stereo field. When the fourth voice finally arrives, it fills the high register and the loop becomes whole. Renaissance-style vocal polyphony meets modern close harmony. The music itself performs the arrival: the high register enters last, and the harmony changes from sparse to full.
